_comment: Real issue payloads recorded from tcyber/ENG. `shape` mirrors the Linear API issue fields this adapter consumes. `injected` fields (blockedBy, labels) are test-only additions, marked as such, because the recorded issues carried none.

issues.title: Add dependency-free regression checks for Work page in verify
issues.description:
Follow-up raised by ENG-80 advisory reviews (PR #10, rounds 1/3/4).

**Problem:** the ENG-80 status-filter fix hinges on one CSS rule. `npm run verify` passes even if a refactor drops it; the failure is purely visual.

**Proposed (no new dependencies):** after `astro build`, assert in the built output that the hide rules survive.

Refs ENG-80.
